scope: Real author-render-reopen round trips and hardened-XML checks using the pinned document library versions in a disposable virtual environment. Not a system installation, not licence/notice/ABI/transitive-closure acceptance, and not human review.

environment.note: disposable venv; the operator environment was not modified

preflight.interpretation: All nine pinned distributions are installed and discoverable. authoringReady and hardenedXmlReady stay false because inspect-only mode never sets the licence, format, runtime and transitive gates; that is by design, not a missing install.

roundTrips.case: docx author -> LibreOffice PDF -> python-docx reopen
roundTrips.author: python-docx 1.2.0 + lxml 6.1.3

roundTrips.case: xlsx author -> LibreOffice PDF -> openpyxl reopen
roundTrips.author: openpyxl 3.1.5

roundTrips.case: pandas read of the authored workbook
roundTrips.author: pandas 3.1.0
roundTrips.note: The formula row carries no cached value and is not returned; that is spreadsheet behaviour, not a pandas defect.

xmlSafety.lxmlHardenedParser: parsed without resolving the external entity; no file content disclosed
xmlSafety.lxmlDefaultParser: parsed with a plain internal entity
xmlSafety.interpretation: Hardened parsers refuse or neutralise external entities; the default parser still accepts them, which is why the hardened path matters.

limits: LibreOffice conversions ran without the cgroup supervisor, because systemd-run --user is denied and the user manager is degraded. Filesystem isolation was not applied to these runs.
No licence text, notice file, wheel manifest, ABI/glibc or transitive-closure audit was performed.
No human review, visual acceptance, macro blocking, form preservation or complex-layout test.
pandas is absent, so the pinned pandas path and its notice refusal remain unverified.

localStackAudit2026_11_02.method: Offline audit of the installed distributions only: METADATA licence fields and classifiers, WHEEL tags, and every RECORD entry hashed against the installed file. No network, no wheel download, no signature service.

runtimeRequirements.note: Extras markers are excluded; platform markers other than extra are treated as active, and version comparison is a simple numeric tuple rather than full PEP 440.

remainingGaps: Wheel provenance and signatures are not verified; RECORD proves the installed files match what pip recorded, not that the wheel came from the publisher.
Notice files, copyright texts and bundled third-party licences were not read.
No CVE or advisory scan and no ABI symbol-level review beyond wheel tags.
Version comparison is not full PEP 440, and platform markers are treated as active.
Human review of the documents produced remains outstanding.

noticeInventory2026_11_02.method: Local enumeration and SHA-256 of licence, notice, copying, authors and copyright files inside each installed dist-info, including any licenses/ directory. No network or credentials.
parentCorrections: A first pass deduplicated by relative path alone, which hid 11 licence files that share the name licenses/LICENSE; fixed by keying on distribution plus path.
A second pass missed pypdfium2 because its licences live under a licenses/ directory with version-named files; those directories are now included.
The naive pattern also missed plural LICENSES entries until the suffix was widened.
limits: Only files whose names match LICEN[CS]E/COPYING/NOTICE/AUTHORS/COPYRIGHT inside dist-info and the installed package directory were read.
Files bundled under other names, or inside data directories outside the package root, are not discovered.
Hashes identify the installed bytes; they do not verify provenance, signatures or licence compatibility.
